description: This file defines roles, permissions, and access control logic for an application, including enums for user roles and sections, as well as functions to determine access rights based on roles.

classes.name: AppRole
classes.description: Enumeration of user roles within the application (ADMIN, STAFF, VOLUNTEER).

classes.name: AppSection
classes.description: Enumeration of different sections of the app that can be accessed (OVERVIEW, DONATIONS, etc.).

methods.name: primaryRole
methods.description: Determines the primary role of a user based on the User object.

methods.name: canAccessSection
methods.description: Checks if a given role has access to a specific section.

methods.name: visibleSections
methods.description: Returns a list of sections visible to the user based on their role.
